basic_info.description: Significant Price Improvement - Now Under $600 per Sq Ft!     Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a well-maintained 1920s-era Marina Style home in the desirable Crocker Amazon neighborhoodnow offered at exceptional value! With 2,191 sq ft, 4 bedrooms, and 2 full bathrooms, this versatile residence is ideal for multigenerational living and combines vintage charm with thoughtful modern updates.    The spacious living room features a cozy gas fireplace and large windows that flood the space with natural light. A formal dining room offers the perfect setting for entertaining, while the updated kitchen provides both function and style. The primary suite includes a private terraceyour own outdoor escape.    Original hardwood floors grace the main level, and a convenient upper-level laundry room adds everyday ease. Ample storage abounds, including attic space and a 3-car garage with bonus room potentialperfect for a studio, workshop, gym, or additional storage.    Outside, enjoy low-maintenance landscaping and a private patio with hot tubideal for relaxing or entertaining. Located on a peaceful corner lot near parks, transit, shopping, and with quick access to Highways 101 & 280, this home offers both comfort and convenience at an unbeatable price.
